ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution toward low-intensity values; estimated macro ratio of white-to-black pixels is approximately 0.04:1, with high-intensity pixels concentrated at distal lobe tips and along the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform low-intensity region across central fluke body; two discrete high-intensity (white/light gray) clusters with irregular, mottled boundaries are mapped to the distal coordinates of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth of ~10% of total horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays three high-amplitude jagged indentations (pixel depth >15) creating a discontinuous profile; left lobe trailing edge exhibits a higher frequency of low-amplitude (pixel depth <5) micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a linear positive-slope trajectory transitioning to a convex curve at the tips; trailing edges follow a broadly concave path relative to the horizontal baseline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (mottling) localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-notch geometric tissue loss on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe trailing edge; extensive white high-contrast scarring/encrustation at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A sequence of deep, non-uniform serrations on the right lobe trailing edge provides a unique identifier relative to the smoother contour of the left lobe.
